scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "bun run --cwd server dev" "bun run --cwd client dev"
scripts.android:sync: bun run build && bun node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor sync android
scripts.android:debug: bun run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: bun run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew.bat assembleRelease
